github_surges.description: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.

歸藏 Game Skill：让 AI 从零做出能在浏览器里玩的 3D 动作游戏，附可玩演示《雾锁山门》。Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex that builds a playable browser 3D action game with AI-generated assets (three.js, single-HTML). Playable demo included.
读了么（BookLeme）· 把一本书编译成 Agent Skill —— 双引擎 + 可插拔体裁插件 + 逐字忠实度回验
Agent skill for narrated cinematic films built entirely from code: one continuous camera over photos, maps and cards, timed to the voice. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI.
SOTA model-agnostic quantization for GGUF, local inference and beyond. Quantize and run text, image, video and audio models with llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers and PyTorch.
First release for Can LLMs Debug Robots by Editing Their Weights? Code, 65-row edit, 16 experiment logs and evidence. V2 and real-robot experiments in progress.
STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
The source code of AXION CS2 internal ragebot.

BLA blinds your agent. LASIK gives it its sight back. Static de-blinding CLI + MCP server that undoes BLA (Blind LLM Agents) hardening so coding agents and REA can read the real code again. Never executes the target.
三个可运行的 AI 工程项目：可追溯 RAG、提示词评测与受守护的 NL2SQL 分析
